reason: The v25 reviewer-authoritative replay completed 120 rows but failed the continuation gate at 52.5% post-type exact sets and 82.5% product-label exact sets. Its reviewer accepted 111 proposals, improved one post-type exact set, regressed two, and changed no product-label exact sets. R80 keeps the same primary, reviewer authority, evidence, batching, provider, and selector boundary while requiring the reviewer to emit exhaustive boolean verdict maps that agree with its complete classification. This is the final bounded DeepSeek Flash prompt-topology test on the consumed-development cohort and cannot approve release.

cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort; unchanged from v18, v23, and v25

production_shape.primary: one complete primary call per batch of at most 20 posts
production_shape.review: one candidate-aware exhaustive-verdict review call per batch of at most 10 post-brand packets
production_shape.verdict_validation: post_type_verdicts contains exactly all thirteen canonical boolean keys and product_label_verdicts contains exactly all five; true keys must equal the reviewer's complete classification, or all keys must be false for context_missing
production_shape.selection: the reviewer's complete validated classification is authoritative; verdict maps validate that judgment but never inject, union, or select labels
production_shape.derived_metadata: decision and ordered closed change reasons are derived from the canonical primary-versus-review diff; exact evidence remains required for changed categories
production_shape.failure: a missing, extra, non-boolean, classification-mismatched, or otherwise invalid review row receives only its one-packet repair and then leaves the post unpublished
production_shape.unexpected_logical_request_capacity: the transport budget permits 20 logical requests beyond the expected 18, shared by primary row fallbacks plus primary and review repair calls
production_shape.global_retry_capacity: each logical request may retry at most twice, while the stricter 58-attempt lane ceiling permits at most 20 transport retries in total after 38 distinct logical requests
production_shape.budget_exhaustion_behavior: fail closed without a candidate; capacity is deliberately not sized for every primary row to fall back or every logical request to retry twice

decision_rule: Continue to the full consumed 500-row development assessment only if all 120 rows validate, overall and each-locale exact post-type sets are at least 0.70, overall exact product-label sets are at least 0.85 and each locale is at least 0.70, outcome accuracy is at least 0.90, context_missing precision and recall are at least 0.50 when supported, and every supported post/product label F1 meets its unchanged floor. Unsupported labels remain support gaps and cannot pass a release gate. A failure stops further DeepSeek Flash prompt-topology tuning.
global_stop: The client reserves the current request's conservative input estimate, full output allowance, transport attempt, and maximum price before network transport. It refuses the first operation that would exceed any cap, including when primary fallbacks, repairs, or retries compete for the stricter global capacity. Cached successful responses replay without new reservations, and capacity cannot transfer to another cohort, provider, model, prompt, or lane.
